title: Assessment checkpoint plan
purpose: Track readiness and support needs during the no-calculus neuron biophysics course.
scoring_note: Use these as mentor check-ins. Except for quiz targets, the goal is to decide what support the student needs next, not to assign a grade.

metrics.metric: Entry diagnostic on graph reading, signs, units, and basic neuron parts
metrics.target: Identify support needs, not a grade
About 80% on core items before moving on
By mid-course, the student should solve the second example in each chapter with only light prompting
Student can explain what a graph shows before naming mechanisms

metrics.when_to_measure: Weeks two, five, six, and seven
metrics.target: Correct units, correct sign, and a sentence of interpretation
Notebook runs top-to-bottom; student can explain each figure
Student makes one evidence-based claim about how noise changes spike timing or variability
